concepts.def: French Protestants fleeing Louis XIV's revocation of Edict of Nantes; brought silk weaving skills to Spitalfields.
Famine refugees fleeing potato blight; over 500,000 settled in Liverpool, Manchester and Glasgow by 1851.
Around 150,000 Eastern European Jews fled Russian pogroms; settled in East End of London.
Ship arriving at Tilbury on 22 June 1948 carrying 492 Caribbean migrants; symbol of post-war Commonwealth migration.
Racial violence in west London where white youths attacked Caribbean residents over three nights in August/September.
First UK law banning racial discrimination in public places under Harold Wilson's Labour government.
